_comment: Model manifest for the offline desktop build. See docs/desktop-architecture.md §3.
Roughly 3.7 GB total with Canary and the Whisper fallback. fetch_models.py
reads this and lays the files out where
The LLM entry is the one real open question (§11). Two 3B candidates are listed;
qwen2.5-3b is the default because it holds a JSON schema better than
llama-3.2-3b in our experience, and grading is the harder half of the job.
Run bench/measure_grading_tokens.py against both before committing.

qwen2.5-3b.note: Stronger on structured output and Hindi code-switching.

llama-3.2-3b.note: Warmer conversational register; weaker at long JSON.

canary-180m-flash-q8_0.note: Primary stop-to-final STT model. Native transcribe.cpp batch inference; not a streaming model.

whisper-small.note: Existing HTTP whisper.cpp fallback for Canary load or inference failures.

whisper-base.note: Smaller emergency fallback if Whisper small does not fit the target machine.

en_IN-navgurukul-medium.note: Custom NavGurukul voice from origin/feature/navgurukul-piper (commit bd348be). The .onnx and its .onnx.json carry over; the Kotlin plumbing does not. Copy both files.

silero-v5.note: Optional. Missing it falls back to the energy VAD, which works but is worse in a noisy classroom.

wav2vec2-phoneme.note: Optional, off the critical path. Needs vocab.json beside it.
